passenger_response.subject: Outcome of your claim – booking AER-3B7Y5K
passenger_response.body:
Dear Tomas Ferreira,

Our record shows that flight AK640 on 2026-08-01 was cancelled because of a cabin pressurisation fault. You were re-routed on AK644. The arrival delay at your final destination was 220 minutes. This is the delay used to assess compensation, rather than the time you personally experienced during the disruption.

We have paid GBP 415.00 under payment reference CMP-00014. This comprises:

- GBP 175.00 compensation. The distance was 1585 km, placing the journey in Band B. The recorded technical cause was within our control. The Band B standard amount is GBP 350.00. Because you were re-routed and arrived 220 minutes late, it was reduced by 50% to GBP 175.00.
- GBP 240.00 for the downgrade. Our record shows that you booked BUSINESS but were carried in ECONOMY. The reimbursement is 50% of the affected segment S2 fare of GBP 480.00. It is not based on the booking total of GBP 1240.00, and taxes, charges and ancillaries are not included. This reimbursement is additional to compensation, not a replacement for it.

This is why the amount is GBP 415.00 rather than the GBP 970.00 you claimed. The calculation must use the arrival delay of 220 minutes, not only the delay you experienced, and the downgrade calculation must use the S2 fare of GBP 480.00 rather than the booking total. We have paid what the policy entitles you to. Anything beyond that is discretionary and is not ours to decide at this desk, so it has been passed on. Please do not read that as agreement that a further payment is due.

Regards,
Aerlink Disruption Desk
